title: Cauchy derivative estimates and growth bounds
section: Complex Variables ▷ Theorems Concerning Analytic Functions
terms: Cauchy derivative estimate; coefficient estimate; polynomial growth.

For entire functions one may let R → ∞. If |f(z)| ≤ C(1 + |z| ) for constants C > 0 and

Coefficient estimates also control Taylor tails. If |f | ≤ M on |z − a| = R, then for |z − a| ≤ r < R,

the remainder after degree N is at most M (r/R) /(1 − r/R). This follows by applying the

chosen radius, optimizing that radius may improve the result.
